ranked.why: Content first. 23 pages, 182 times. Extract (98): the answers drop tick marks, list numbers, a table's last rows or columns, the second line of a cell. Rectify (69, one PDF page): a flat page taken for a photograph and cropped to one table. Layout (8): a Zone cut through a line.

24 pages, 178 times. Locate (74, 9 pages): the unclaimed pass keeps fragments and copies of lines already read. Layout (73): overlapping or nested Zones draw their content twice. Caption (13): a Title repeated as its Zone's first line. Zones over blank strips invent 'The'.

9 pages, and 4 more added (layout: beside). Card grids and side-by-side blocks drawn one under another: the cards read as one table or list Zone, or a second Zone given a band of its own. The main cause of the height faults.
12 pages, and 11 added. A band, card or header split into one box per Zone; card fills found by the furniture but placed in no Zone; a badge with its pixels drawn as a mark.
24 pages major (37 in all). Mostly the consequence of the two classes above: stacks where the page sets things side by side, and bands split apart.
10 pages. Numbered items read as items with a bullet, the number lost or drawn after the bullet (extract).

10 pages. Misreads in the extract answers: 'Luis' as 'Luls', 'initiative' for 'iniziative'.
26 pages. A bold value under a regular label in one cell or pair carries no run, so the cell is all bold or all regular (inline runs); pairs often carry no look (cv:looks).
33 pages. Render (37): a block's size not applied, lines drawn at the body's size. cv:looks (20): sizes mismeasured (0.25, 0.30, 0.41 of the body), some unreadable.
